login.title: Sign in
login.text: Enter your mobile number and we'll send you a 6-digit code on WhatsApp.

login.note: We never share your number. Restaurants only see your name when they scan your visit code.

login.expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
login.blocked: This account is blocked. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.

profile.signInTitle: Sign in to collect your visits
profile.signInText: Every visit a restaurant confirms raises your level. Browsing and booking work without an account.
profile.visitCodeText: Ask the restaurant staff to scan it so your visit counts.
profile.visitCodeRule: The code changes every minute. One visit per day per restaurant.
profile.publicText: Lets people see your reviews and level, and follow you from Level 4.
profile.deleteText: Your visits and level will be deleted for good and cannot be restored.
profile.notifyFollowingText: Offers and events from restaurants you follow, and new reviews from critics you follow.
profile.notifyCampaignsText: Seasonal campaigns and specials - at most twice a week.
